card: SS-2026-11-W1-05 · reel_motion (code-rendered motion graphics, voiced), tier O30 (20 to 35 s) · job convert · belief B5 ('a system beats buying pieces'; vault line: 'You don't need more marketing. You need marketing that works together.') · awareness solution_aware · cta_type keyword: comment ANALIZA (the live keyword) · hook_type comparison · narrow product: the same boosted post followed twice, once with nothing after the click, once with a path after the click (a reply, a second message, a booking step); the boost is a piece, the path makes it work. Must NOT imply that boosting doesn't work. AI label on (AI voice).
facts:
- The owner's own words: 'paratë e reklamave zhduken' (the ad money disappears). He has tried boosting posts and more ads.
- B1: 'Your ads aren't failing. Your enquiries are dying after the click.'
- The free analysis: free, 45 minutes, at our office in Tirana or at the client's business, no obligation. Next step: comment ANALIZA; a DM sends the booking step.
- Nothing about what the analysis covers, finds or shows.
- No euro amounts, no results, no counts.
hook:
Visual from frame 1: a click pointer taps an unbranded mock post card (a drawn shopfront picture, a small megaphone icon meaning 'promoted', no platform label, no logo, no numbers). The view jumps to a messages screen headed 'Mesazhet' (Messages): completely empty, a comic tumbleweed rolling across. The two-lane comparison starts after 3 s.
Text hook (top third, 0-3 s): 'Paratë e reklamave zhduken? / Shiko pas klikimit.' [Ad money disappears? / Look after the click.]
Spoken L1 (fixed): see line 1.
structure: ST10 comparison (the same post, two endings), compact, second-person narrator. O30 rungs: recognition (L1), the cause in one picture line (L3), the fix (L4, L5: the path, the missing piece), CTA keyword (L6).
end_card: Ivory card: 'Komento ANALIZA' large; below: 'Analizë falas · 45 minuta · në zyrën tonë në Tiranë ose te biznesi yt · pa detyrim' [Free analysis · 45 minutes · at our office in Tirana or at your business · no obligation]; small line 'Hapi për rezervim vjen në mesazh' [The booking step comes in a message]; StraightScale wordmark. Held to 31.0 s.

lines.sq: Paguan sponsorizimin, njerëzit klikojnë, dhe pastaj asnjë mesazh. Ku shkuan?
lines.en: You pay for the boost, people click, and then not one message. Where did they go?
lines.super: 0-3 s text hook 'Paratë e reklamave zhduken? / Shiko pas klikimit.'
lines.visual: Pointer taps the unbranded promoted post card; jump to the empty 'Mesazhet' screen; a comic tumbleweed rolls across and off.

lines.sq: Ndiqe të njëjtin postim dy herë.
lines.super: 'I njëjti postim, dy herë' [The same post, twice]
lines.visual: The post card splits into two identical cards, side by side, two lanes; a red dotted path line waits under each.

lines.sq: Herën e parë, pas klikimit s'ka asgjë. Njerëzit shohin dhe ikin.
lines.en: The first time, after the click there's nothing. People look and leave.
lines.super: '1: pas klikimit, asgjë' [1: after the click, nothing]
lines.visual: Left lane: the pointer clicks; the dotted path runs a short way and stops at empty space. Small simple figures (icons) look at the card and walk off the edge. The tumbleweed passes.

lines.sq: Herën e dytë, pas klikimit ka rrugë: përgjigje, mesazh i dytë, rezervim.
lines.en: The second time, after the click there's a path: a reply, a second message, a booking.
lines.super: '2: përgjigje, mesazh i dytë, rezervim' [2: reply, second message, booking]
lines.visual: Right lane: the same click; a figure writes a message, and the path lights three stops in order: a reply bubble, a second message bubble, a booking card with a calendar icon (no dates, no numbers).

lines.sq: Sponsorizimi s'kishte faj. I mungonte pjesa tjetër.
lines.en: The boost wasn't to blame. It was missing the other piece.
lines.super: 'Sponsorizimi s'kishte faj' then 'I mungonte pjesa tjetër' [The boost wasn't to blame / It was missing the other piece]
lines.visual: Both lanes: the left lane's broken path gets a puzzle piece that slots into the gap; its path now runs on like the right one.

lines.sq: Komento ANALIZA: analizë falas, dyzet e pesë minuta, në zyrën tonë në Tiranë ose te biznesi yt, pa detyrim.
lines.en: Comment ANALIZA: a free analysis, forty-five minutes, at our office in Tirana or at your business, no obligation.
